gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-encode-sans-semi: Chunky pixel charm up top, with a tubelike line that never swells. Encode Sans Semi Condensed, a modern sans-serif, is the quiet counterweight, its open shapes making the loud heading feel like a deliberate choice.

Encode Sans Semi Expanded takes the text, its rounded letters left wide open and its manner contemporary. Pixelify Sans above it is the opposite: bold, bent-wire pixel lines, so the two sit together like a game screen beside a tidy notebook.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-exo: Expressive and a bit cheeky, Pixelify Sans draws its display letters with no thick-thin swell at all. Exo is the approachable sans-serif underneath, with wide gaps between its shapes.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-exo-2: Pixelify Sans is all stiff, bent-steel strokes with no variation in thickness, which gives it a loud, blocky personality. And Exo 2, a plain sans with generous daylight inside its curves, keeps paragraphs moving smoothly beneath it.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-faculty-glyphic: Faculty Glyphic brings modern, clear openings to the rounded letters of the text, and it stays composed. But Pixelify Sans overhead writes like a marker nib ignoring direction, so the page gets a playful jolt and then settles down.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-fahkwang: Fahkwang reads as contemporary and friendly, with faint pressure shifts in its round letters and curves that finish early. Pixelify Sans, a wire-bent display face, handles the headings, so long paragraphs feel gentle.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-figtree: Blocky pixels meet marker-tip softness here. And if Pixelify Sans were shrunk down, its bold heading character would fade, while Figtree, a sans-serif, would feel oversized if made large.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-finlandica: Finlandica carries the text with open-mouthed e crossbars and an outline you could trace with a finger. Finlandica is the sans-serif for steady reading, while Pixelify Sans, with bold pixel lines, is the one built to make an entrance.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-fustat: Lines like bent tubing give Pixelify Sans its bold, expressive look, and it does its best work as a loud display heading. Fustat, a modern sans, is better at the quiet job of carrying text.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-gantari: Pixelify Sans looks bent from wire, bold and expressive. Gantari, a sans with wide c apertures, brings the same wire-bent look across words but softens it, and that shared quality is what ties the pair together.
